research.job_description_summary: Oracle hires freshers in India as Associate Software Developers. Glassdoor reviews (December 2025 to June 2026) describe five rounds in one case (online assessment, two technical rounds on DSA, core concepts, puzzles and OOP, a project-based discussion with DSA, and HR), an on-campus process with a DFS problem, multithreading and in-depth projects (January 2026), and a screening plus technical and behavioral questions on prior projects (June 2026). The official careers pages were not fetched.
limitations: Oracle's official careers pages were not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.

Candidate-attributed material is four Glassdoor reviews on one page; they give topics, not full problems. The only named problem is 'sort an array of 0, 1, 2' (December 2025). Items based on them carry one report each and are unverified.
A review of an August 2023 interview (posted August 2024) supplies the SQL joins and rank topics; it is older than the 2025 cutoff and is marked low confidence.
Round titles come from a single reviewer's five-round list and may not match other teams' processes.
Puzzle, OOP and behavioral prompts are original practice.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
Source pages on LeetCode Discuss and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to the CodeArena audit tool (2026-10-11), so the cited questions were not re-confirmed against those pages.
